title: Acquire simultaneous hopping intervals with paid tomography
statement: Under support-complete isolation,calibrated coherent axis preparation/readout and biases,ordinary pair tomography at tau=1/(4L),L=2a_max+Delta_max+d_max gives simultaneous amplitude intervals. For delta_total<=min(tau*epsilon/3,1/24),the near-identity matrix-log bound yields |a_hat-a|<=epsilon. Nine settings per environment pattern and N>=2 delta_stat^-2 log(18M/alpha) repetitions per setting suffice.
